sources.title: Git — git-rebase
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: GNU Make：相依圖與增量建置
related.titleEn: GNU Make: dependency graphs and incremental builds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付before-after-graph.csv、range-diff與回復演練紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver before-after-graph.csv, range-diff and a recovery rehearsal.
related.difference: 畫出h到兩個object再到app的DAG，分別測serial與-j2的理想關鍵路徑。
related.differenceEn: Draw the DAG fromh through both objects toapp; compare serial work with the ideal-j 2 critical path.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
rebase重播變更到新base，父節點改變通常導致新commit ID；patch相近不表示原提交仍在同一歷史位置。
教學基準：3+2 = 5 commits；對照：3-0 = 3 commits。

target相依決定需要重建的傳遞閉包；時間戳模型必須把真正輸入列入，否則產生陳舊輸出。
教學基準：2+2+1 = 5 s；對照：max(2,2)+1 = 3 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Rebase replays changes onto a new base; changed parents normally produce new commit IDs; similar patches do not preserve historical position.
Teaching baseline: 3+2 = 5 commits; comparison: 3-0 = 3 commits.

Target dependencies determine the transitive rebuild closure; timestamp-based builds need every real input declared to avoid stale outputs.
Teaching baseline: 2+2+1 = 5 s; comparison: max(2,2)+1 = 3 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: QuickCheck：變形測試與排序預言機
related.titleEn: QuickCheck: metamorphic testing and sorting oracles
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付before-after-graph.csv、range-diff與回復演練紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver before-after-graph.csv, range-diff and a recovery rehearsal.
related.difference: 使用輸出恆為空清單的錯誤函式，證明排序與冪等皆可能通過；對非空輸入，多重集合性質必須失敗。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Use a constant-empty implementation to show that ordering and idempotence can both pass; multiset preservation must fail on nonempty inputs. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
rebase重播變更到新base，父節點改變通常導致新commit ID；patch相近不表示原提交仍在同一歷史位置。
教學基準：3+2 = 5 commits；對照：3-0 = 3 commits。

基準 50*3 = 150 assertions；對照 50*4 = 200 assertions。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
使用輸出恆為空清單的錯誤函式，證明排序與冪等皆可能通過；對非空輸入，多重集合性質必須失敗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Rebase replays changes onto a new base; changed parents normally produce new commit IDs; similar patches do not preserve historical position.
Teaching baseline: 3+2 = 5 commits; comparison: 3-0 = 3 commits.

Baseline 50*3 = 150 assertions; comparison 50*4 = 200 assertions. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Use a constant-empty implementation to show that ordering and idempotence can both pass; multiset preservation must fail on nonempty inputs.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
